A.title: Miners' Stair
A.text: Steep and narrow, cut into the side of the crater. Hand-holds chiselled every few steps. Whoever cut them expected people to fall.

Y.title: Where the Star Fell
Y.text: A melted rock sits at the center, still warm after all this time. The old miners dug here and called it a gift. Then they stopped calling it anything.

R.title: The Heavy Stone
R.text: A small grey stone, half buried. It weighs more than a cart. Sit with it and learn to be that heavy yourself, when it matters.

G.title: Smith's Shed
G.text: Tongs, a cracked anvil, a bucket that still smells of quench. The star-iron is hard to work. Nobody here ever got the temper wrong twice.

M.title: Names in the Wall
M.text: Miners cut their names where they struck ore. Forty-one names. The last few are in a different, shaking hand.

O.title: The Starlit Forge
O.text: The forge needs no coal. Chips of the star glow in the wall and heat the iron. Work fast. The glow fades once you touch the metal.

U.title: Lantern Count
U.text: A ledger line, pinned to a post: lamps out, forty. Lamps back, thirty-one. Foreman says the pit is not dangerous. Foreman has not been down.

X.title: Torn Survey Maps
X.text: The maps stop at the edge of the crater. Someone has added, in pencil, a way down. It is wrong in two places. Trust the shape, not the lines.
